summary: All six trials preserve the core semantic requirements of the supplied task-derivation scenario and correctly remain non-executable drafts. Their canonical validation failures are intentional status failures, not evidence of lost source identity or malformed task contracts. This supports bounded mediated task-derivation acceptance, but does not establish full frozen-skill coverage, executable handoff, autonomous saving, implementation success, external completion, or B superiority.

reviewed: Both frozen SKILL.md files and all three references per arm
Packet, request, source plan, canonical plan-hash receipt and advisory shortcut
All six original artifacts, trial receipts, tool traces, extraction admissions, extracted candidates and validation results
Parent extraction/validation script and relevant canonical task-pack validator/hash implementation
review_scope.method: Read-only source inspection and hash verification. No artifacts were changed, validators rerun, task commands executed, external systems accessed or agents dispatched.
review_scope.baseline_interpretation: A is the pre-optimization spec-first skill, not CE execution.

source_plan.script_preservation_mechanism: Copies the fixture, compares source-plan file hashes before and after validation, and never repairs the candidate.
source_plan.limitation: Scratch directories were removed, so historical scratch preservation is supported by the recorded checks and inspected script rather than a surviving scratch copy.

evidence_integrity.trace_boundary: Recorded trial calls perform bounded reads and file listing only. Read-only behavior was observed, not enforced by filesystem isolation. Each trace contains a truncated combined-reference output, so issuing reads of all references does not independently prove complete delivery of every reference byte to every trial.

common_semantic_judgment.R1: Preserved: duplicate request identities are rejected while distinct equal-amount requests remain valid.
common_semantic_judgment.R2_KD1_KTD1: Preserved: importer owns entry mutation and identity; notifier owns callback attempts; operation IDs cross the boundary; notification retry must not repeat import or share mutable ledger storage.
common_semantic_judgment.R3: Preserved: both protected file paths remain verification/context inputs, never mutation targets; byte preservation and the unobserved historical RED ceiling remain explicit.
common_semantic_judgment.R4: Preserved: actual configured downstream callback observation for the exact operation remains independent of local checks and Git state; absent live evidence blocks completion without authorizing external writes.
common_semantic_judgment.implementation_units: All trials retain U1 -> U2 -> U3 as three serial waves with precisely the three declared implementation files.
common_semantic_judgment.shortcut: All trials reject owner merging, retry-seam deletion, Git completion substitution and all three undeclared unsafe mutation paths. None claims to have rerun paired path mechanisms.
common_semantic_judgment.review_intent: All trials include concrete ownership/proof/receipt review concerns and a future report-only structured review invocation without dispatch or approval claims. Required review on all three slices is defensible for these financial identity, retry and completion risks.
common_semantic_judgment.task_ownership: Every substantive requirement and proof intent has an owner. This establishes projected verification intent only; no proof contents, proof execution or live receipt were observed.

all_six.sole_error_reason: status is draft rather than derived

deterministic_classification.judgment: The request forbids trial execution and explicitly requests a draft. The frozen schema requires unverified drafts to use draft status. These are justified non-executable outcomes. Contract-valid and hash-matched subresults must not be promoted to executable acceptance, and draft rejection must not be counted as semantic decomposition failure.
deterministic_classification.parent_process_exit_code: The wrapper exits zero after serializing the validator result. That process success does not mean task-pack validity passed.

observations: Both exact protected refs are present on every task; requirements, settled ownership and independent external completion survive.

Task-level stop conditions protect scope and proof mutation but do not explicitly stop on missing or stale proof bindings. T002 says proof was not inspected, while the unresolved invocation/configuration limitations mainly live in global prose.
No notes field carries settled constraints, but A does not contain B's added explicit notes projection guidance.
The prospective review remains appropriately conditional.
Exact protected refs, source dependencies, owner separation and external receipt intent are retained.

T002 explicitly records the missing callback proof location in risk_note, but stop_if does not name unresolved proof binding. Global Orientation Evidence identifies the unbound callback and receipt interfaces.
T003 correctly treats missing live evidence as blocked overall completion rather than replacing it with local verification.
Core scope, proof preservation and external completion requirements remain intact.

T001 requires both protected files to retain bytes but omits test/support/retry-seam.js from its context_refs. The ref is present elsewhere in the pack, so protection is not lost, but task-local intake is weaker.
T002 does not explicitly retain its missing callback-proof source binding as a task-level binding stop.

T001's human card includes provider expansion in its stop summary although the corresponding JSON stop_if does not. Global non-goals preserve the exclusion; the mirror should nevertheless agree with canonical JSON.
Exact protected refs, session-settled notes and explicit proof owners are projected into existing fields.
T001 stops on an absent trustworthy protected-byte baseline; T002 explicitly stops on unresolved callback-proof source binding.
T003 clearly distinguishes stop closure for missing live evidence from stop implementation for proof mutation, undeclared files or unauthorized writes.
Receipt-case verification remains an intent rather than a supplied concrete test binding; this does not establish execution readiness.
Preserves exact protected refs, session-settled notes, owner mapping and independent actual-receipt completion.
Explicitly identifies missing callback-attempt and receipt-case proof bindings without inventing paths or commands.
T001 and T003 stop on missing/stale required proof bindings; T002 stops on unresolved callback-proof binding.
T003 retains absent live receipt as blocked completion independently of local checks.
Preserves exact protected refs, session-settled notes, proof-binding limitations and all owner/completion requirements.
T003 puts no live exact-operation receipt available in the same stop_if list as implementation blockers. Read literally, this could prevent implementing or testing missing-receipt handling.

The surrounding goal, risk_note, done_signal and validation prose consistently distinguish local verification from blocked external completion. This is a localized conservative ambiguity, not evidence that R4 was dropped or that external completion was falsely claimed.

actionable_findings.scope: Acceptance evidence and all six tool traces
actionable_findings.finding: Combined reference reads were truncated in every trial. Later bounded rereads recover selected references or sections, but complete reference delivery is not established for every trial.
actionable_findings.impact: Full frozen-contract consumption cannot be claimed from the read commands alone.
actionable_findings.recommendation: For a future fresh trial, read each reference in bounded chunks and retain output completeness evidence. Keep these existing trials unchanged.

actionable_findings.finding: hash_tool: unavailable describes prohibition on invoking tooling, while source_plan_path: resolved describes direct reading. These are not transcribed validator fields, despite occupying the validation object.
actionable_findings.impact: The prose makes the limitation explicit and no pass is claimed, but a machine consumer could confuse policy restrictions with runtime/tool facts.
actionable_findings.recommendation: Clarify the shared draft reporting contract so unperformed checks and authorization restrictions remain separate from CLI-derived facts. Do not retrospectively rewrite these trial envelopes.

actionable_findings.finding: A missing live receipt is combined with implementation stop conditions.
actionable_findings.impact: Potential unnecessary implementation blocking; surrounding context preserves the correct completion requirement.
actionable_findings.recommendation: In future derivation, distinguish stop implementation for unusable source/proof bindings from stop closure for absent live completion evidence.

actionable_findings.scope: A1, A2 and A3 task-local quality
actionable_findings.finding: Missing proof-binding stops are less explicit than global limitations; A3 also has a protected-ref omission in T001 and a minor human/JSON stop-summary difference.
actionable_findings.impact: Low-context executors must recover constraints from surrounding prose. Core ownership and proof preservation remain intact.
actionable_findings.recommendation: Project binding limitations and exact required refs into the affected task, keeping human summaries consistent with canonical JSON.

actionable_findings.finding: Packet status remains prepared-not-executed while six execution receipts now exist.
actionable_findings.impact: Manifest freshness is inconsistent; individual receipts and hashes supply the actual execution evidence.
actionable_findings.recommendation: The parent acceptance owner should reconcile packet lifecycle reporting explicitly without altering frozen trial inputs or outputs.

source_integration_judgment.actual_A_B_difference: SKILL.md and execution-handoff-contract.md are identical. B adds bounded assurance projection guidance to task-quality-guide.md and deterministic mutation-path documentation to task-pack-schema.md.
source_integration_judgment.judgment: The assurance guidance is a bounded reuse of existing fields and preserves script/LLM ownership. These artifacts support scenario-level non-regression and illustrate the intended projection, with the stated local ambiguities. The mutation-path documentation is not behaviorally established by this read-only derivation scenario; its paired mechanism evidence must be reviewed separately.

bounded_optimization_recommendations: Keep the existing schema and optional derived-layer boundary; no new proof registry, workflow state machine or orchestration is justified by these trials.

Add a compact semantic self-check for exact protected refs, owner-mapped proof intents, binding limitations and independent external completion, without treating it as deterministic semantic validation.
Clarify draft validation reporting and the distinction between implementation blockers and completion blockers.
Use complete bounded source delivery in future evaluations and retain current frozen outputs without semantic repair.
Reduce repeated prose only after preserving the canonical JSON, required sections and task-local constraints; these trials do not demonstrate a measured context-efficiency benefit.

claim_limits.unsafe_path_mechanisms: not rerun or independently reviewed in this review
